filters.resetEarly: Filters changed early? Reset the timer

restart.title: Restart
restart.intro: Restarting helps after network changes. Settings are kept.
restart.installing: Installing… ventilation is back in about {{s}} seconds. Don't switch the unit off meanwhile.
restart.restarting: Restarting… ventilation is back in about {{s}} seconds.
restart.backLoading: The unit is back. Loading the new version…
restart.late: The unit hasn't come back yet. Check that it has power and is connected to the network, then reload this page.
restart.textInstall: Ventilation stops for about {{s}} seconds while the new firmware is installed. Don't switch the unit off meanwhile. You'll need to log in again. Settings are kept.
restart.text: Ventilation stops for about {{s}} seconds. You'll need to log in again. Settings are kept.

ha.title: Home Assistant
ha.intro: Shows the unit in Home Assistant through MQTT, with all modes, levels and temperatures.
ha.brokerHint: IP address or DNS name (.local names don't work)
ha.retype: Enter it again for the new broker.
ha.passwordRemoved: The saved password will be removed when you save.

network.title: Network
network.intro: Changes take effect after a restart. If the unit becomes unreachable, edit HELIOS/CONFIG.INI on the SD card.
network.restartNeeded: Restart the unit to use the new network settings.

clock.title: Clock
clock.intro: The schedule and summer cooling need the correct time.
clock.ntp: Get the time from the network (NTP)

password.title: Password
password.askText: Everyone, including you, is logged out.

fans.title: Fan levels
fans.perKrpmHint: Used to estimate the fresh-air figure on Overview. Default 118.

frost.title: Frost protection
frost.intro: When it's freezing outside, moisture in the outgoing air can turn to ice in the heat exchanger. The unit stops this in two steps, and you usually don't need to change anything here.
frost.step1Text: Below {{temp}} outdoors, if heat recovery falls under {{pct}}, more warm room air goes through the heat exchanger.
frost.step2Text: If that hasn't helped after {{boost}}, the supply fan stops for {{defrost}} so the warm room air melts the ice.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.intro: All settings as CONFIG.INI, for a backup or to edit on a computer. Passwords aren't included.
backup.askText: The uploaded file replaces every setting except the password. Network changes take effect after a restart.
